scene: Pocketing the wet key, you find three distinct transit gates ready outside.

shown: a sleek red monorail carriage idling at an elevated gantry far left
a wooden funicular car waiting on steep sloped tracks to the right
a mechanical brass rickshaw with a smiling robot driver on the far right
